firstPlayerRule: Whoever has lived in the same place the longest drafts first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Give that person the First Player Card. Players draft one villager at a time in clockwise order.
Drafting comes before building. In the Build Phase, each player finishes their building actions before the next player acts.
At the end of the Build Phase, pass the First Player Card to the player on the left.
Solo mode uses the Countess: after drafting a card for yourself, assign a face-up Road villager to her Village before replenishing the Road.

The two-player reverse-order coin placement on page 11 occurs after drafting and does not select the opening player. No address or new interpretation of same place is requested.
